name: Online onboarding and KYC credential issuance
description: A prospective customer opens a bank account remotely. The bank identifies them against the e-ID and issues a reusable KYC attestation.

name: Periodic KYC re-evaluation
description: The bank re-runs customer due diligence on an existing relationship at the interval its supervisor requires, reusing the identity already established.

name: Re-identification after a forgotten password
description: An existing e-banking customer who has lost their credentials is re-identified before access is restored, without a branch visit.

name: Re-identification at the age of majority
description: A customer onboarded as a minor turns 18. The relationship is re-established at full legal capacity, with a qualified electronic signature.

name: Issuance of a Maturitätszeugnis
description: An upper-secondary school issues the school-leaving certificate to the graduate as a digital attestation.

name: University immatriculation
description: A university admits a student on the strength of the e-ID and the Maturitätszeugnis, without re-collecting or re-checking paper documents.

name: Age verification at the point of sale
description: A merchant or a restaurant checks that a customer is over the legal age for a restricted product, learning nothing else about them.

name: Employee identity proofing and onboarding
description: An employer identifies a new hire and checks the qualifications the role requires, before provisioning any account.

name: Automated aerospace supplier onboarding
description: A manufacturer qualifies a new supplier by checking its legal existence, its signatories and its quality accreditations.

name: Patient identification at admission
description: A hospital identifies a patient at admission and links them to the right record.

name: Access to an online government service
description: A resident authenticates to a public-administration service portal and proves the attributes the service is entitled to see.
